title: Future Policy
paragraphs: “Ptooey! Why did Gaelion have to give the first kiss I was saving for Naofumi to a Filolial, na~no!?”
“Uuuh… Mel-chan… Naofumi… I was kissed by a dragon…”
Sakura-chan started sobbing softly.
Damn… because of the rival, Sakura-chan had to go through such a heartbreaking experience…
“Rival, are you ready to die?”
I feel like I can now fully master the Wrath Curse, which used to be Father’s specialty. Without hesitation, I will erase the rival from this world.
“There, there…”
“Naofumi! Gaelion wants to be comforted too, na~no! That kiss with a Filolial was just a mistake, na~no! Help me, na~no!”
“You’re the one who initiated the kiss…”
Father comforted the crying Sakura-chan while giving the rival a look of disbelief.
“Now then, I’m going to kill her!”
“Na~no! I will absolutely survive, na~no! Even if I die, I’ll come back to life, na~no!”
“Motoyasu-san, calm down!”
Itsuki and Ren stepped in between us, trying to stop the fight.
What is this? Are they siding with the rival? Depending on the situation, I will just have to hurt her enough to not kill her.
The crime of tarnishing Sakura-chan is punishable by death!
“Well… to be honest, I think the cause of all this is you, Motoyasu-san. Please listen to me first.”
At that moment, Itsuki raised his hand and started explaining.
Why is this my fault?
If you get in my way, I’ll treat you like I did when I locked you up!
“Yeah… that movement of Gaelion just now looked familiar to us. Naofumi, you noticed it too, right?”
“Eh? Well… I guess, kind of…”
Father nodded at Ren’s question and looked at me. Then, big sister and her friend also nodded.
“It looked similar to how the Spear Hero plays with Yuki-chan and Kou.”
“Yeah.”
“Ugh… this is hell… The lust of the Spear Hero, which should have been driven out of Gaelion, is still writhing inside, na~no…”
The rival wiped her mouth several times and declared.
“You’re trying to pin all of this on me! I won’t allow it!”
“I’d rather die than kiss a Filolial!”
As she said this, the rival tried to charge at Sakura-chan again, but big sister’s friend stroked her tail, holding her back.
“So… Motoyasu-san’s love for Filolials has infected her, huh?”
“That’s a disease I definitely don’t want to catch.”
“We need to suppress the Spear Hero’s influence, na~no… Hurry up and give me a large shard of the Dragon Emperor, na~no! Otherwise, I don’t know if I can withstand it, na~no!”
“Ugh… understood.”
Though I didn’t want to, I handed the rival a shard of Takt’s dragon. The rival transformed into a dragon, ate the shard, and crushed it.
“Ugh… I think I can hold it down somehow, na~no. But the force is so strong that I’m not sure if I can completely suppress it, na~no. I might need some time to recover, na~no…”
“If you can control it properly… maybe you can get along with the Filolials?”
“No way, na~no!”
“Absolutely not!”
Sakura-chan and the rival voiced their opposition in unison. I don’t want that either. If they get too close, I’ll drive them away with my spear.
“Even though they’re supposed to be natural enemies, this is the power of Motoyasu-san’s Lust Spear at work.”

“To get stronger, I had to embrace such a terrible power, na~no. I need to control it quickly, or I won’t be able to give my first time to Naofumi, na~no. Gaelion has no intention of laying eggs with a Filolial, na~no! Na~no, Filo—”
As she said that, the rival looked at Sakura-chan and was about to leap at her again. However, big sister’s friend stroked her tail and stopped her.

“Ugh… I thought there was an annoying obstacle earlier, but this is helpful, na~no. Please stop Gaelion’s rampage until the control is complete, na~no! Or better yet, I want the Filolials to disappear from Gaelion’s sight, na~no!”
“You’re the one who should disappear!”
“Well, well… then, why don’t we have Sakura-chan and the others return to the village first?”
“Yeah… Sakura wants to go back to the village quickly.”
“A troublesome dragon has arrived! Naofumi-sama, I suggest you dispose of it quickly.”
“Kou is the one who should be getting stroked by Rifana, not her…”
Sakura-chan was on the verge of tears, Yuki-chan was annoyed, and Kou looked enviously at the rival being stroked by big sister’s friend.
“Hmm… maybe we should isolate her for a while? For now, her cooperation is going to be essential moving forward.”
Ugh… her skills alone are top-notch! Sakura-chan and the Filolials were sent back to the village first.
“So, Gaelion…”
“Call me with a ‘-chan,’ na~no.”
With the Filolials gone, the rival took the opportunity to start appealing.
“Gaelion-chan. Just to be sure, do we really not need to recruit your big sister and father, the ones who were your allies in the previous loops?”
The rival nodded repeatedly.
“Na~no na~no! It’s fine, na~no. Rather than dragging them into unnecessary battles, I want them to live peacefully, na~no. This is what Gaelion truly wishes from the bottom of her heart.”
“Well… we don’t have any contact with them now, so I can’t really say for sure…”
“Your parents wanted to return the assistant to the human world!”
“That can wait until the world is at peace, na~no!”
“That makes sense. In the case of Raphtalia-san’s village, it was something that needed to be done, but this doesn’t seem to be something that needs immediate attention.”
“Yeah. If there’s even a chance that they might end up unhappy because of me, I’d rather they stay where they are and continue to build a happy life.”
“Ren-san, is that really okay? We’re talking about your future girlfriend here.”
“Leave that aside for now!”
Ugh… I feel like I’m surrounded by enemies. I don’t care about the rival’s parents, but the assistant was also managing the Filolials, so I had a certain amount of respect for him.
“Alright. Then, Gaelion… -chan’s wish is for us to leave those two alone.”
“Yeah.”
“Understood.”
“Thanks to Gaelion-chan, things are about to get lively.”
“Leave it to me, na~no! Now, Naofumi, you can ask Gaelion for anything, na~no.”
“Ah, yeah. I’ll think about it. Alright, let’s head back. Gaelion-chan, be careful around the Filolials.”
“Got it, na~no! Even Gaelion took a lot of damage, na~no!”

And so, we returned to the village, and the days passed by. After that, thanks to the detailed information provided by the rival, Forbry and the other countries succeeded in exposing the transmigrators, reincarnators, and possessors who were the vanguard of the waves, leading to a uniformly peaceful situation. Now, we heroes are gathered in Father’s room on a night in the village where reconstruction is steadily progressing. We are here to discuss our future plans. Most of the tasks that Father and the others had asked us to handle have been taken care of, so we decided to consult with each other. Unfortunately, the rival is also present. Big sister has finally stopped crying at night recently. She often sleeps with her big sister.
“So, Motoyasu-kun and Gaelion-chan. What’s next on the agenda?”
“Hmm… The current issues have been resolved, and after some time following the next wave, the activation of Cal Mira Island will occur, na~no.”
The rival is blatantly trying to seduce Father. Lately, Father has gotten used to it and just brushes it off.
Is it thanks to big sister’s big sister?
“Activation, huh? Since we went to the Drauquier Mountains before, we know what it’s like.”
“Is there any point in going? I think we’ve already gained enough strength.”
“That’s true.”
Ren and Itsuki are still saying the same thing as always. It seems that once they judge that their level is high enough, they lose their motivation.
“There is meaning! This is the start of the Filolial-sama cultivation plan!”
“Ah… well, I guess so. That’s Motoyasu-kun’s ambition, after all.”
“You’re trying to find that Filolial, right?”
“Even though you haven’t found her yet, you’re still at it?”
“This is madness, na~no. Because of that, Gaelion has been through a lot, na~no!”
Everyone, including Father, is sharing their opinions.
Should I kill the rival later?
“I don’t know how many loops it’s been, but if you still can’t find her after all this, maybe it’s time to consider looking for the reason?”
“But I don’t know how to find Filo-tan.”
“You’re not out of options, are you? If you loop again, create the same situation as in the first world and let Naofumi-san go with the flow. That way, you can reproduce the same circumstances.”
“I can’t do something like that.”
Not helping Father goes against my principles.
Are you telling me to just stand by and watch as he gets deceived by that pig? If I ever see that happen again, I will jump in and kill that pig immediately.
